title: Pepe Bros
summary: A little frog. A legendary leap. Rescue the Golden Lily across eight seeded platforming levels.
description: Guide Pepe through Moonlit Swamp, Crystal Caves, Sky Lily Pads and the Bog King's Castle. Collect golden flies, discover bonus caves and power-ups, stomp beetles and outsmart four bosses. Share a seed and chase your personal best. Original 3D diorama art and synthesized music, with strictly 2D platforming, three lives, instant replay and offline play after download.
controls: Move: A/D or Left/Right. Jump: Space, W or Up; hold to jump higher. Run: Shift. Fire: J or X after Fire Fly. Pause: P or Esc. Enter a glowing pipe: S or Down. Mobile: left/right, Jump, Fire and a contextual Enter pipe button. Touch movement runs automatically.
